This is the dataset for replay testing, behavioral analysis, or any task where you care about what the benchmarked model actually did ...

sources.title: Fine-tuning a 35B model on agent traces beats bigger judges at lower ...
sources.snippet: LangChain and Fireworks showed that fine-tuning a 35B model on actual agent traces can match or beat the big frontier models at judging agent output. The cost drop is massive. Matching big models on narrow tasks changes where the real edge sits They took Qwen-3.5-35B and trained it on multi-turn traces from two agent setups.

sources.title: openai_agents_cookbook.ipynb - Colab
sources.snippet: In production, evaluation provides real-time insights into how agents perform on user data. This section simulates a live production setting, showing how you can collect traces, model outputs, and evaluation results in real time. Another option is to pull traces from completed production runs and batch process evaluations on them. You can then log the results of those evaluations in Phoenix.
